info.description: To access detailed ZPA API documentation, including references and use cases, refer to the [Zscaler Help Portal](/zpa/about-zpa-api).

get.description: Gets the application segment mapping details for the specified customer.

parameters.name: customerId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the application segment.

parameters.name: microtenantId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the Microtenant for the ZPA tenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained from the API Keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations is limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant.

domainNames.description: The list of domains and IP addresses. The maximum limit for domains or IP addresses is 2,000 applications per application segment. The maximum limit for domains or IP addresses for the whole customer is 6,000 applications.

name.description: The name of the application resource.

description.description: The description of the application resource.

defaultIdleTimeout.description: The duration of the default idle timeout.

defaultMaxAge.description: The default maximum age of the resource.

enabled.description: Whether or not this application resource is enabled.

passiveHealthEnabled.description: Indicates if passive health checks are enabled on the application.

tcpPortRanges.description: The list of TCP port ranges used to access the application.

udpPortRanges.description: The list of UDP port ranges used to access the application.

tcpPortRange.description: The list of TCP port ranges used to access the application.

udpPortRange.description: The UDP port ranges used to access the application.

doubleEncrypt.description: Indicates if Double Encryption is enabled (true) or disabled (false) for the application.

segmentGroupId.description: The unique identifier of the segment group.

segmentGroupName.description: The name of the segment group.

configSpace.description: Indicates if the configuration is created as part of the SIEM or application resource.

bypassType.description: Indicates the bypass type when users bypass ZPA to access applications.

healthCheckType.description: Whether the health check is enabled (DEFAULT) or disabled (NONE) for the application.

icmpAccessType.description: The ICMP access type of the application.

isCnameEnabled.description: Indicates if Zscaler Client Connector receives CNAME DNS records from App Connectors.

clientlessApps.description: List of clientless or Browser Access applications. If a list of Browser Access applications are provided, then the field matchStyle must be set to EXCLUSIVE.

praApps.description: The list of Privileged Remote Access applications.

ipAnchored.description: Whether Source IP Anchoring for use with ZIA is enabled (true) or disabled (false) for the application.

bypassOnReauth.description: Indicates if application access during reauthentication bypasses ZPA (Enabled) or not (Disabled). For example, if your IdP is configured to do multi-factor authentication (MFA) for off-premises users, enabling this option redirects the user to the IdP via the internet where the IdP prompts the user for MFA. For on-premises users, enabling this option redirects the user to the IdP via the internet where the IdP prompts them for MFA. This feature requires versions Zscaler Client Connector 4.3 or later for Windows and macOS.

inspectTrafficWithZia.description: Enable to leverage single posture for securing internet or SaaS and private applications and apply Data Loss Prevention policies to the application segment you are creating. If Source IP Anchor is enabled, you must disable it prior to enabling Inspect Traffic with ZIA as both features cannot be enabled at the same time.

healthReporting.description: Indicates the health reporting of the application.

useInDrMode.description: Whether or not the application resource is designated for disaster recovery.

tcpKeepAlive.description: Indicates if TCP Keep Alive is enabled (1) or disabled (0) for the application segment.

appRecommendationId.description: The unique identifier of the recommended application.

selectConnectorCloseToApp.description: Whether the App Connector is closest to the application (true) or closest to the user (false).

inconsistentConfigDetails.description: The details of the inconsistent configuration.

matchStyle.description: Indicates if Multimatch is enabled for the application segment. If enabled (INCLUSIVE), the request allows traffic to match multiple applications. If disabled (EXCLUSIVE), the request allows traffic to match a single application. A domain can only be INCLUSIVE or EXCLUSIVE, and any application segment can only contain inclusive or exclusive domains.

tcpProtocols.description: Indicates the AD Protection protocols to be inspected on the specified TCP port ranges. This field is only required if adpEnabled is set to true.

udpProtocols.description: Indicates the AD Protection protocols to be inspected on the specified UDP port ranges. This field is only required if adpEnabled is set to true.

isIncompleteDRConfig.description: Indicates if the disaster recovery configuration is incomplete (true) or not (false).

adpEnabled.description: Indicates if Active Directory Inspection is enabled or not for the application. This allows the application segment's traffic to be inspected by Active Directory (AD) Protection. By default, this field is set to false. If adpEnabled is set to true, then the field matchStyle must be set to EXCLUSIVE. If adpEnabled is set to true, then autoAppProtectEnabled cannot be set to true.

autoAppProtectEnabled.description: If autoAppProtectEnabled is set to true, this field indicates if the application segment’s traffic is inspected by AppProtection. If set to true, a valid AppProtection enrollment certificate must be generated to inspect application segment traffic by AppProtection. If adpEnabled is set to true for Active Directory Inspection, then autoAppProtectEnabled cannot be true.

apiProtectionEnabled.description: If true, designates the application segment for API traffic inspection.

fqdnDnsCheck.description: If true, perform a DNS check to find an A or AAAA record for this application.

weightedLoadBalancing.description: Indicates if the application load balancing configuration for application segments is enabled (true) or disabled (false).

extranetEnabled.description: Indicates if the application is designated for Extranet Application Support (true) or not (false). Extranet applications connect to a partner site or offshore development center that is not directly available on your organization’s network.

zpnErId.description: The ID of the Extranet application.

shareToMicrotenants.description: The unique identifier of the Microtenant that the application segment is being shared to. This field is required if you want to share an application segment.

matchStyle.description: Indicates if Multimatch is enabled for the application segment. If enabled (INCLUSIVE), the request allows traffic to match multiple applications. If disabled (EXCLUSIVE), the request allows traffic to match a single application. A domain can only be INCLUSIVE or EXCLUSIVE, and any application segment can only contain inclusive or exclusive domains.

id.description: The unique identifier of the server group.

modifiedTime.description: The time the server group is modified.

creationTime.description: The time the server group is created.

modifiedBy.description: The unique identifier of the tenant who modified the resource.

name.description: The name of the server group.

microtenantId.description: The unique identifier of the Microtenant for the ZPA tenant. If you are within a Microtenant, you must pass the microtenantId field when making an API call to retrieve data from that Microtenant. The microtenantId can be obtained from the API Keys page, or can be obtained programmatically using the ZPA cloud service API. Access to certain operations is limited when you are within a Microtenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. If the microtenantId is not passed in the request when creating or updating a resource, then the resource is created or updated in the Default Microtenant.

enabled.description: Whether or not the server group is enabled.

dynamicDiscovery.description: Controls dynamic discovery of the servers.

description.description: The description of the server group.

configSpace.description: Indicates if the configuration is created as part of the SIEM or application resource.

weight.description: The weight of the load balancing configuration. Weights with a lower value indicate that a lesser number of requests are served by the App Connectors linked to the server group. Weights with a higher value than other server groups indicate that the App Connectors linked to the server group serve a greater number of requests. Server groups with weights set to 0 do not route requests.

passive.description: Indicates if the server groups are in an active state and can load balance (false), or if the server groups stay passive (true).

extranetEnabled.description: indicates if Extranet Application Support is enabled for the server group. These field is only applicable for server group endpoints, and is not applicable for Policy Set or Policy Rule endpoints.
